rationale: No supported optimization is safe to apply. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency caching) is contraindicated because the workflow already caches Maven dependencies: the ci job uses actions/setup-java with cache: maven and the native job uses graalvm/setup-graalvm with cache: maven, so an equivalent cache already exists. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST provides no change because strategy.fail-fast defaults to true in GitHub Actions (the OS x JDK matrix already cancels remaining jobs on failure), and the supporting evidence is synthetic with negligible measured savings; explicitly setting it would not alter behavior and the every-matrix-outcome-required contraindication applies to a cross-platform compatibility matrix. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative per-job duration history (only five workflow-level runs, all ~2 minutes) and risks failing valid slow runs on macOS/windows runners, so a timeout limit cannot be set safely; its supporting evidence is from a simpler Node.js check workflow. Build/test coverage is preserved as-is.
